Chatham County

The Salvation Army Chatham County Crisis Assistance Program is a social service agency that assists individuals and families in various capacities to prevent homelessness and address the client's basic needs that lead to self-sufficiency, such as food, clothing, hotel vouchers, rental, and utility assistance.

content:wysiwyg_basic:1786044156895:0.12.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:1786044156895:0.12.html:
The Housing Crisis: Pathway to Success Program
An expansion of The Salvation Army Greensboro Crisis Assistance Program.  It is a comprehensive collaborative project to assist households at or below the federal poverty guideline with flexible service delivery that fills gaps of services in the community’s response to Homelessness, Housing Instability, Poverty, Unemployment, Underemployment, Childcare, Transportation, Mental Health and Substance Abuse for up to 2 years.   The Salvation Army Greensboro and Chatham County goal is to eliminate barriers and reducing challenges associated with people in a housing crisis by operating a housing crisis center.

Participants that are experiencing a housing crisis can contact The Salvation Army of Chatham County at (336) 763-6400 between the hours of 9:00 AM and 4:30 PM Monday – Friday to speak to a housing specialist to interview and determine the appropriate services needed based on each individual’s situation.

content:wysiwyg_basic:1786044160162:0.39.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:1786044160162:0.39.html:
Emergency Financial Assistance

  • Financial Assistance is open to Chatham County residents ONLY. 
  • Applicants may receive assistance ONCE EVERY TWO YEARS. 
  • Please specify Rent/Utility
  • Please provide valid photo ID and a copy of a past-due bill or late rental notice. 
  • To qualify for assistance:
    • The bill or lease MUST match the name of the applicant. 
    • Applicants must meet Health and Human Services Current Income Guidelines (to be completed at intake interview) 
    • Rental Assistance applications must have an eviction letter or late notice from the landlord or court. 
    • Provide a copy of current lease agreement and a copy of current lease"ledger" stating payment history. 
  • Due to sustainability and funding restrictions, you may be required to show proof of income to receive assistance. 
  • Applicants are required to provide a valid photo ID. Accepted forms of ID are Driver's License, State ID, Prison ID, Student ID, Work ID, Passport, or any government-issued ID with a picture on it. Birth certificates for children in the household. 
  • You must be in a crisis to receive emergency assistance funds, meaning you are behind in a utility or rental bill, resulting in imminent disconnection or eviction. 

All items must be present at the time of the appointment.

content:wysiwyg_basic:1786044162352:0.05.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:1786044162352:0.05.html:
Supplemental Assistance 

  • Emergency/Supplemental shelf-stable groceries and frozen entrees are distributed as available during regular office hours. There is no income requirement for food assistance. 
  • Chuckwagon Weekly Frozen Entree Di
    • Every Friday between 11:30 am and 1:00 pm at Countryside Collectibles/Harbor Freight parking lot on Highway 64 East in Siler City (look for the "Free Meals Today" sign). 
  • A small amount of supplemental clothing, personal care, and survival needs (sleeping bags, blankets, seasonal accessories) is a distributed as available during regular office hours. There is no income requirement for these items. 
  • Bundles of Hope Diaper Program - Generous Community Members provide a quarterly donation of diapers, wipes, formulas, and baby clothing in various sizes. SUPPLIES ARE LIMITED. 

Countryside Collectibles FOOD BOOTH

  • The Chatham County Service Unit maintains a booth at the Countryside Antique Mall at 219 Chatham Square, Highway 64 E in Siler City. The merchandise changes weekly, and sales from all food, clothing, and accessories benefit our community. 

Food assistance is in collaboration with:

West Chatham Food Pantry - Siler City
• Monday: 4:30-6:00 pm
• Wednesday: 12:30-2:00 pm
• Friday: 12:30-2:00 pm

CORA Food Pantry - Pittsboro
Monday-Friday: 10:00-2:00 pm

No referral is required, but you must have two forms of ID

  • You need to present a picture ID and Social Security number for everyone living in your household to enter into HMIS.
  • Households are eligible for food once per month.
  • Food assistance is provided as available at our Siler City office
